study: Aquifer-conductivity epistemic bracket propagated through the Phase 3 annualisation (defence-brief item A2)

scope.statement: bulk-d70 and prior-side ONLY. This is the co-primary grain-size reading, not a sensitivity; the matrix reading is the companion record conductivity-bracket-annualisation.json. The Phase 2 posterior side of both readings is the companion record conductivity-bracket-posterior-side-bulk.json, run 2026-08-21. Quote this scope wherever any number here is quoted.

gate_1_reproduces_production_table.criterion: every field string-identical to the published table

gate_2_arm_provenance.criterion: grid equal to baseline, N = 1e5, config hash round-trips, expected prior_mean_scenario label

gate_3_non_bep_segments_invariant.criterion: every segment with no BEP source is bit-identical to baseline under every arm

B1.statement: under bulk the contest is driven by the upward arm, not the downward ones

B2.statement: the upward arm reverses KP 57.4 +4K and KP 58.8 +4K

B3.statement: the upward arm does not reverse KP 62.0 in either climate

B4.statement: the matrix P4, that the upward arm reverses no ordering anywhere, does NOT replicate under bulk
B4.note: held here means the matrix prediction failed to replicate

B5.statement: KP 57.4 and KP 60.0 cannot REVERSE historically, overflow being exactly zero; KP 57.4 historical collapses under the lowest arm

B6.statement: the lowest arm reverses KP 60.0 +4K, the one warmed cell piping still leads under bulk; the milder downward arm does not

B7.statement: the climate ratio rises under the downward arms and falls under the upward arm

B8.statement: the blanket unit weight control changes no ordering and moves every annual number by under two per cent

B9.statement: the annualised conductivity span is wider under bulk than under matrix at every cell, and wider than the length-effect bracket

C1.statement: the two brackets act on the same piping numerator in opposite directions: the bulk reading suppresses piping, the upward conductivity arm restores it

C2.statement: at least one cell whose lead the bulk reading hands to overflow is restored to piping by the upward arm

C3.statement: the conductivity bracket still changes the lead at every cell the grain-size reading flips

C4.statement: across the union of both readings and the full bracket, the only cells whose lead is invariant are those where overflow is exactly zero

BF1.statement: no arm changes any lead under bulk (the bracket would be inert where the curves sit lowest; would indict the pipeline)

BF2.statement: a cell whose overflow annual is exactly zero reports overflow as the leading mechanism (bug signature)

BF3.statement: the bulk conductivity span is narrower than the matrix span at every cell (would refute B9)

BF5.statement: if B2 fails it fails at KP 58.8 +4K, which needs a factor of 9.43 against a matrix multiplier of 2.81

lambda_ac_bracket_yardstick.definition: published system P_f at lambda_ac = 40 m divided by 250 m, posterior side, matrix, primary surface (phase3_report section 6.2)
